Move the phone slowly over the floor or the table until it recognises the horizontal surface. It is quicker on a well-lit, patterned surface.
The rig records the depth, revolutions, torque, the concrete pressure measured at the top of the auger (swan neck) and the concrete volume for every metre.

The toe and the soil plug
The cage must be placed immediately after concreting: the fluid consistency and the retarder let the cage sink under its own weight.

If the auger turns too fast for its rate of advance, it brings up more soil than it drills out, and the ground around the bore loosens. So the rig measures and controls the ratio of revolutions to advance.
